title: Project setup and repository baseline
body: Initialize repo structure, branch strategy, contribution rules, CI placeholders and documentation links.

title: Architecture skeleton
body: Create architecture folders, ADR template, high-level service skeleton and environment map.

title: API foundation
body: Create API service skeleton, OpenAPI placement, contract testing placeholder and auth boundary.

title: Data foundation
body: Create data model package, migration placeholder, schema conventions and DQ hooks.

title: Forecasting foundation
body: Create ML/forecasting package layout, model registry placeholder, feature pipeline skeleton.

title: Frontend portal foundation
body: Create web app skeleton, role-aware routing placeholder and dashboard shell.

title: Mobile foundation
body: Create mobile app skeleton and push notification integration placeholder.

title: Admin/backoffice foundation
body: Create admin module skeleton and sensitive-action audit pattern.

title: Billing and entitlements foundation
body: Create billing domain model and entitlement enforcement placeholder.

title: Observability and operations foundation
body: Create logging/metrics/tracing placeholders and operational runbook links.

title: QA and acceptance framework
body: Create test strategy mapping, acceptance checklist and release gates.

title: Security and compliance baseline
body: Create security controls mapping and compliance evidence placeholders.
